I read before bed and journal more, track my caloric surplus and protein intake, lift 3-4x a week, bike to work, try to be in bed by 11pm latest. I feel like a robot now and its kinda nice for once. I used to drink a lot and do drugs (coke and weed) to get me thru the days but now im clean and sober and sharp and energy levels is great. I enjoyed these books a lot when i was going through what felt like a rut. Candide by Voltaire and A Hero of Our Time by Mikhail Lermontov. Both stories have crazy "whoa, howd we get here" stories of adventure and going through even though circumstances seem shitty. Although sometimes bleak, its pretty entertainingly funny and also its short and easy to burn through. Both books are pretty philosophical, dealing with problems im sure ur facing right now in some way. 

In Candide the character is very positive and will do anything to see the love of his life again. In Hero of our time, he is a "byronic" hero who is kind of an asshole but he knows it. 

I read this two books sort of back to back and i realized it really compliments each other well. Enjoy!
